_comment: Decisions APS-Conecta made. Extends _base.json; lists concatenate, scalars override.
_comment_licence: ADR 0010 supersedes 0007: AGPL-3.0-or-later across every repo. The apps link @nextcloud/vue (AGPL), so the obligation is inherited, not chosen.
_comment_language: Dual regime since ADR 0006 (docs/adr/0006-documentacion-en-espanol.md): English by default; a repository carrying the .github/docs-es marker follows ADR 0006's Spanish must-list — reader-facing docs Spanish, dated history untranslated, the licence name keeps its English proper noun. Only the org profile/README.md is bilingual ES/EN.
_comment_language_exempt: Deliberately Spanish: a doc is exempt when its READER is Spanish-speaking (the staff-facing conventions, the clinical guide, the staff manuals) or when Spanish is its SUBJECT (the statutes and the legal obligations — the law as published, and material about Spanish domain terms). Entries match by path suffix. gestion's USER_MANUAL.md is Spanish under a recorded deferral, not an exemption — it stays a finding until its translation lands. Everything else in Spanish is a finding.
_comment_must_be_spanish: ADR 0006: files whose body prose must be Spanish in every opted-in repo (the .github/docs-es marker). Paths match exactly, never by suffix: docs/guias/README.md is not README.md.
_comment_must_be_spanish_documentation: The documentation repo alone (matched on the repo fact, never a glob) widens the list: its notice and its four directory trees owe Spanish to their readers. A trailing slash is a directory prefix; every other entry is an exact path.
_comment_site_structure: scribe Q24: an opted-in repo (empty marker .github/site-structure) types every page under these dirs with front matter (tipo, audiencia, apps, resumen) and a fixed H2 skeleton per tipo, or per the esqueleto override. A name prefixed '?' is optional; the H2s present must follow the skeleton's order and carry nothing else. index.md pages owe the front matter only. apps are checked against the catalog file when the repo has one.
_comment_retired_paths: ADR 0006: manuals live only in APS-Conecta/documentation and the legacy English paths below are retired — an opted-in repo carrying one deletes it rather than maintains it. Probed on the working tree, not the git index: an untracked straggler or a non-markdown file is invisible to tracked_md() and equally present. Three entries also sit in doc_language_exempt deliberately: exempt explained why a Spanish doc existed; retired says the path must not exist at all.
_comment_versions: Components whose documented version must match compose.yaml.
_comment_leak: Added to the universal set — Spanish wording and our own infrastructure notes.
_comment_boxes: Checklist wording in our SECURITY.md, mapped to the setting that settles it.
_comment_notices_doc: docs/LICENSING.md dropped: gestion's retained copy is no longer the engine's notices document, and the transitional licence-inventory warn on it is accepted until R4.
_comment_single_tenant: Wording that presumes one clinic where the software is multi-site: sites/<slug>/site.sh, a 2655-row DEIS register, and gestion ADR-0013 (the establishment is instance configuration; moved out of epidemiologia 2026-08-09). 'CESFAM' as a clinic TYPE is correct and must not match.
_comment_code_owners: Who reviews. One account today; every commit in every repository is his and no other account has access.
_comment_root: Where the clones live is machine-local, not policy: see config.json.
_comment_docs_es_sections: ADR 0006: the README of a repo carrying .github/docs-es owes these H2 sections, in this order. Slugs are stable identifiers; heading text is compared accent-insensitively (the engine folds).
_comment_repo_readmes: Forked repos carry their real README at .github/README.md; every repo not listed reads the root README.md.
_comment_docs_es_licence_link: The Licencia section must carry one link whose URL contains both substrings — the organisation's notices document.
